Based in the UK, we are steel detailers known for our quick turnaround times. Fabricators prefer our detailing services for their efficiency and accuracy.
Steel detailing is often compared to assembling an Ikea flat pack unit. The key differences are:

1. We work with steel.

2. Our drawings are far superior and easier to follow.

If you remember building “Airfix” models, you'll appreciate our meticulous and detailed approach. Embrace precision and efficiency with our steel detailing services.
